```yaml
name: Desktop Release

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  release:
    name: Release Desktop App
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [macos-latest, ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: lts/*
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          cache: true
          cache-workspaces: './src-tauri/Cargo.toml'

      - name: Install dependencies (Ubuntu)
        if: matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y libgtk-3-dev libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev libappindicator3-dev librsvg2-dev patchelf

      - name: Install dependencies (macOS)
        if: matrix.os == 'macos-latest'
        run: |
          brew install create-dmg

      - name: Install npm dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build Tauri App
        uses: tauri-apps/tauri-action@v0
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          TAURI_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.TAURI_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          TAURI_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.TAURI_KEY_PASSWORD }}
        with:
          tagName: v__VERSION__
          releaseName: "ClawdStrike v__VERSION__"
          releaseBody: "feat(enclaves): origin-aware policy enforcement\n\nImplements the Origin Enclaves feature — origin-aware security enforcement for AI agent workflows."
          releaseDraft: true
          prerelease: false
```
